body.name: finite positive rank-two joint constraint map
body.construction: For \(Z,W\in\{0,1,2\}\), choose a nonsingular rank-two minor \(C_a\) and partition \(B_a=\left[\begin{smallmatrix}C_a&D_a\\E_a&F_a^{B}\end{smallmatrix}\right]\), \(b_a=(b_{a,\mathrm{top}},b_{a,\mathrm{bot}})\), and \(d=(d_{\mathrm{top}},d_{\mathrm{bot}})\). Define \(\Xi(P)=\{F_a^{B}-E_aC_a^{-1}D_a,\ b_{a,\mathrm{bot}}-E_aC_a^{-1}b_{a,\mathrm{top}},\ d_{\mathrm{bot}}-D_a^\top C_a^{-\top}d_{\mathrm{top}}:a=0,1\}\), with the same marginal vector \(d\) in both arms.
